intro: YuuSell ("we", "our", or "us") values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data when you use our services through our website or any other communication channels.

information.title: 1. Information We Collect
information.intro: We may collect the following types of personal information:
items: Name, phone number, email address, and shipping/billing addresses
Payment information (processed securely via third-party providers)
Package content descriptions (for customs and logistics purposes)
Device and usage data (e.g., IP address, browser type, and pages visited)

how-we-use.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
items: Communicate with you about your orders

sharing.title: 3. Sharing Your Information
sharing.intro: We may share your information with:
items: Shipping and logistics partners (for delivery purposes)
Government agencies (if required by customs or law)
Third-party service providers who assist in operating our website and services

security.title: 4. Data Security
security.content: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights
rights.intro: Depending on your location, you may have the right to:
items: Access or update your personal information
File a complaint with a data protection authority

cookies.title: 6. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies to improve user experience and collect anonymous traffic data. You can control cookies via your browser settings.

third-party.title: 7. Third-Party Links
third-party.content: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites.

changes.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally. Changes will be posted on this page with a new effective date.

contact.title: 9. Contact Us
contact.intro: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
